name: descriptive modifiers
description: Descriptive variations shared by generated characters and creatures

fields.Name: Scarred
fields.Description: Old scars mark their body and hint at dangers they survived.

fields.Name: Pale
fields.Description: Their coloring is unnaturally pale, making familiar features seem strange.

fields.Name: Ornate Markings
fields.Description: Distinctive natural markings form elaborate patterns across their body.

fields.Name: Weathered
fields.Description: Exposure to harsh weather has left them rough, patient, and visibly worn.

fields.Name: Alpha
fields.Description: The subject has the bearing of a dominant leader that coordinates peers and protects group cohesion.

fields.Name: Hybrid
fields.Description: The subject shows traits from a second species, suggesting one useful ability and a contradictory weakness.

fields.Name: Undead
fields.Description: The subject appears free of several biological needs and bound to the cause or rite of reanimation.

fields.Name: Reinforced
fields.Description: Armor, mutation, or magical protection visibly suggests unusual resilience against ordinary attacks.

fields.Name: Gigantic
fields.Description: The subject is extraordinarily large, with imposing reach and presence but difficulty in narrow spaces.

fields.Name: Enraged
fields.Description: The subject appears recklessly aggressive after injury, dangerous in manner but increasingly predictable.

fields.Name: Pack
fields.Description: The encounter is narrated as a coordinated pack, without changing generated group size or mechanics.

fields.Name: Swarm
fields.Description: The encounter is narrated as many small creatures acting as one threat, without changing generated group size or mechanics.

fields.Name: Ectoplasmic
fields.Description: The subject appears partly able to cross matter but must seem material to affect the physical world.

fields.Name: Invisible
fields.Description: The subject is hard to see, though scent, sound, and interaction with the surroundings may reveal it.

fields.Name: RULE Bearer
fields.Description: The subject appears to wield a RULE-like phenomenon with an ordinary user’s limitations; no RULE is selected or granted.

fields.Name: Equipped
fields.Description: The subject appears to carry anatomy-appropriate weapons or objects; no equipment is selected or added.
